trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation & Oil Markets
trends.summary: Trump threatens Iranian infrastructure strikes; 50% of Iran's missile launchers remain intact. Kuwait refinery drone attack ignites fires. US oil closed at $112/barrel with 63-hour trading halt. Geopolitical risk driving commodity volatility and energy cost inflation across supply chains.

trends.name: Food & Commodity Price Inflation From War
trends.summary: UN food price index rose 2.4% in March to 128.5, second consecutive monthly increase driven by Middle East conflict. Higher energy and freight costs cascading through global supply chains. Fed watching inflation impacts on both pricing and consumer disposable incomes.

trends.name: Private Credit Outflows & Systemic Risk
trends.summary: Investor redemptions from private-credit funds accelerating, threatening Wall Street's new kingmakers. Fed's Williams monitoring closely but doesn't see systemic risk yet. Market repricing underway amid 'clear reasons' for recent developments. Major liquidity watch for credit markets.

trends.name: Microsoft AI Investment & Japan Tech Surge
trends.summary: Microsoft announcing $10 billion AI investment in Japan for infrastructure and cyber defense. Sakura Internet jumped 20% on SoftBank partnership news. Microsoft executives touting Copilot sales traction despite AI sector anxiety. Major capital deployment signaling AI infrastructure buildout confidence.

trends.name: Chinese Chip Firms Hit Record Revenue on AI Boom
trends.summary: Chinese semiconductor companies achieving record revenue driven by AI demand surge and US export restrictions creating supply gaps. Geopolitical policy directly supporting domestic chip sector growth. Iran threatening US tech companies adds cyber risk dimension to sector.

trends.name: Mortgage Rates & Housing Cost Pressures
trends.summary: Mortgage rates rising for fifth consecutive week as energy price inflation pushes Fed expectations higher. Homebuyers paying measurably more since Iran war began. Housing affordability headwind intensifying as rate expectations adjust to war-driven inflation.

trends.name: Retail Earnings & Dividend Stock Upgrades
trends.summary: Best Buy upgraded despite sales headwinds—dividend and low P/E attractive. Robinhood new bull cycle forming (rating upgrade). Box undervalued. Starbucks turnaround moves disappointing market. Membership hikes at Sam's Club signal pricing power; Costco/BJ's could follow.

trends.name: Nasdaq Valuation Gap & Market Timing Questions
trends.summary: Rare valuation gap opened on QQQM (Nasdaq-100 tracker). Ed Yardeni signals US markets bottomed Monday. Analyst debate on valuation gaps in growth stocks amid macro uncertainty from geopolitical risks and inflation.

trends.name: Manufacturing Resilience Despite War Headwinds
trends.summary: US manufacturers showing resilience despite Middle East conflict outbreak, though facing rising prices and supply delays. Broader industrial sector navigating geopolitical disruptions while maintaining production. GXO Logistics rated buy but with rising macro risks flagged.

trends.name: Transportation & Airline Cost Pass-Through
trends.summary: United Airlines raising checked bag fees by $10 as fuel costs climb. Airlines passing through energy inflation to customers. Broader transportation sector pricing power test as oil prices remain elevated.

trends.name: Crypto Regulation & Stablecoin Progress
trends.summary: Coinbase clears key regulatory hurdle in stablecoin business expansion. Regulatory clarity improving for crypto sector. Significant approval milestone for institutional crypto infrastructure buildout.

trends.name: Treasury/Rates Market Dysfunction & Solutions Gap
trends.summary: Markets still searching for solutions to rates market stress despite ongoing commentary. War-driven inflation expectations colliding with Fed policy uncertainty. Structural questions about duration, real rates, and curve dynamics unresolved.
